cars.note: Continuously polling OBD-II PIDs while the car is locked causes the BMS and MCU to stay awake, which will degrade the 12V AGM battery. While charging, the pack holds full voltage around 14 V. To protect the battery, set Sleep voltage to 12.0 V (Power Saving > Sleep Mode), and set Low-Voltage Behavior to "Pause PID polling only (Custom Voltage)" (Automate > Settings) and the "Pause below (V)" voltage to 12.7 V, so polling stops after the car is switched off.
